name: Competitor Teardown
summary: Compares positioning, pricing and messaging of named competitors from their public pages.
description: Fetches competitors' public websites with a configured web tool, extracts positioning, pricing and key claims, and produces a comparison table plus differentiation opportunities. Every cell links back to the page it came from.
problems: I don't know how to position against competitors
I want to see how competitors price and message
I need a battlecard for my team

outputs.label: Comparison table
outputs.description: Positioning, audience, pricing and claims per competitor.

steps.name: Fetch pages
steps.responsibility: Retrieve homepage and pricing pages for each competitor.

steps.name: Extract and compare
steps.responsibility: Extract claims and pricing into the comparison schema.

steps.name: Verify citations
steps.responsibility: Ensure each cell cites a fetched page.

dependencies.reason: Market context helps rank which differences matter.

criteria.description: Every comparison cell cites a fetched page.
